import_instructions: 1. In n8n: Workflows → Import from file → select this JSON
2. Open the workflow and click 'Fellow Trigger' node
3. Under Credentials, create a new 'Fellow API' credential (subdomain + API key)
5. Under Credentials, create a new 'GitHub API' credential (PAT token + username)
7. Confirm webhook registered: check Fellow Settings → API, MCP & Webhooks → active webhooks
